mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, f.feedback_type, f.title, f.content, f.images, f.contact, f.status, f.reply_content, f.reply_time, f.handler_id, h.nickname AS handler_nickname, f.create_time FROM sys_feedback f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON f.handler_id = h.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.id, f.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, f.feedback_type, f.title, f.content, f.images, f.contact, f.status, f.reply_content, f.reply_time, f.handler_id, h.nickname AS handler_nickname, f.create_time FROM sys_feedback f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON f.handler_id = h.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(f.reply_time, f.create_time) DESC, f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_feedback SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
